proposed.text: A Meralco-billed commercial building has a measured monthly peak demand of 62 kW (recorded as 15-minute average). The service is 380V three-phase at 0.87 power factor. What is the approximate feeder current at peak demand?
proposed.rationale: Three-phase feeder current: I = P / (sqrt(3) * V * PF) = 62,000 / (1.732 x 380 x 0.87) = 62,000 / 572.6 = 108.3 A. The original '115.6 A' answer used an incorrect denominator of 537.0 instead of 572.6. Meralco bills on the highest 15-minute average power demand recorded each month. Source: Philippine Electrical Code three-phase current formula and service/feeder sizing provisions.
